scope: Bounded native handoffs directly read from pinned source; not a full consumer trace

consumers.meaning: Native first crossing clamps positional bounds and can maintain settled history. RE13 itself makes neither clamp nor cache invalidation; history update and lookup belong to provider.
Reflected lower first_less delegates first_greater at sign-copied threshold, preserving position. Correctness requires source and reflected row index alignment.

Bearish reference swaps views and lower index after original detector construction; wrappers mirror candidate/candle, analysis, sign-copy threshold and return hit. Detect mirrors accepted reactions and negates Reset broken_level, keeps bounds. Full view lifetime and projection remain pending.

Unified successor admission requires expected tag and non-null analysis, rejects strict remainder crossing of analysis.extreme, then consumes full main lower window. Unlike standalone, it cannot seed solely from full main OHLC without exact analysis; tie keys remain distinct.

Unified retained nontrend first search passes first_only=true and retain_initial=true to bullish/reference _scan, captures helper cursor; copies bullish or reflects bearish candidate. Nonretained route uses public detect and copies first reaction. Trend routes differ.

Unified post-confirmation reset uses exact analysis.extreme when present or box fallback, delegates direction-specific reset; emits or tries shared successor, passes pending reset to normal cursor. No conflation with standalone level or early return.

Unified normal scan uses pending reset OR strict previous-owner crossing plus separate candidate-break predicate, invokes race only when both true; retained checkpoint uses shallow copies and counts. Standalone WAITING race condition differs; complete ledger and rollback not reviewed.

remaining: Full reflected/cache ownership, projection and Unified lifecycle, ledger, dirty frontier, rollback, failure paths and other owners.
